markers.name: Andersen V1
say:
Your performance up to now has been exemplary.
You should all be very proud.

Our next objective is clear.
We are heading into space and will attack the most powerful Rapture there is.
markers.label: NPC 7003028

markers.name: Dorothy V2
say:
We are the Goddesses.
Victory is a given.

A mission to defeat the head Rapture... 
If it's us, we can do it.
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V2
say:
Corruption...
I thought it was all an urban legend.

Those eyes... could they perchance enhance one's physical abilities?
Should thou not protest, might we engage in a friendly duel?
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Lilith V2
say:
Haha, don't worry too much everyone.
We're supposed to have a fair amount of reinforcements for this mission.
Should we get ready to meet our new recruit?
markers.label: NPC 7003029

markers.name: Rapunzel V2
say: V.T.C. has been investigating the corruption.

If the corruption is caused by some kind of virus...
there must be a way to treat it.
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: SnowWhite V2
say:
Don't ever say you're going to die, 
not even as a joke.
Trying to force your way through with another headlock, are you?
markers.label: Character 224

markers.name: Dorothy V1
say: You both need to quit wasting your energy on pointless martial arts training and channel your energy into something more meaningful.
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V1
say: What in the heavens are you rapscallions up to now?

You seem awfully relaxed,
given the circumstances.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Lilith V1
say: Hehe, you two seem in high spirits today.

I have some pro wrestling videos
if you need some inspiration.
markers.label: NPC 7003029

markers.name: Rapunzel V1
say: I'm glad that you two always train so hard.
I'll join you right after I finish praying.
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: SnowWhite V1
say:
Red Hood, are you goofing off again? 
The commander is calling you. Hurry up!
markers.label: Character 224

markers.name: Angry Soldier V1
say:
Quit talking out of your rear.
You think the Raptures are just gonna stand by and let a tasty meal like us pass them by?

What are you doing?
Stop wandering around and maintain your positions!
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Coward Soldier V1
say: I hope we won't have to fight any Raptures...
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: FM Soldier V1
say:
While the Goddess squad is on the field,
we need to protect this airship!
Maintain your positions and don't scatter!
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Fool Soldier V1
say:
This airship
is humanity's ace in the hole, created by
gathering top engineers from around the world.

The ship has been temporarily christened Wings of Victory,
but this is only meant as a placeholder.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Justice Soldier V1
say: To have been part of the Goddess squad's mission...!

I feel that I can die now without any regrets.
Oh, don't take that the wrong way. I'm not intending on dying anytime soon.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Andersen V2.1
say:
We're about to reach the mission area. 
Rest while you can.

I'm going to emphasize once again that our mission is simple. 
After riding the Lift, we are to eliminate the Rapture Queen.
markers.label: NPC 7003028

markers.name: Doroth V3.1
say:
Rapunzel has locked the door and isn't coming out.
What on earth did you show her?
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V4
say:
What kind of person am I?
Goading others to accomplish things I myself cannot achieve.
... I'm missing it more than usual today.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Lilith V3.1
say:
How are you feeling?
Do you want to lie down?

Hehe, judging from your voice, you seem fine.
Should we start preparing?
markers.label: NPC 7003029

markers.name: SnowWhite V3.1
say:
Red Hood...
Is the pain okay now?

I only have one wish.
Stay with us until the very end.
markers.label: Character 224

markers.name: Andersen V2
say:
First the corruption, and now all this business with the latest mission.
This whole thing stinks.

At any rate,
she's either run off, or she's dead.
markers.label: NPC 7003028

markers.name: Hongryeon V3
say: By the heavens, what a handful.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Lilith V3
say:
I feel I have a rough idea of what they're hoping to create
through these Nikke and Rapture fusion experiments.
markers.label: NPC 7003029

markers.name: Rapunzel V3
say:
How are you feeling now,
Red Hood?

It'd be best if you head to the infirmary and get looked at properly. 
Dorothy, please take good care of Red Hood.
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: Angry Soldier V2
say:
Well, they're not birds, I can tell you that much.
Quit staring and start shooting!

You fool! Where are you going to run to?
Do you want to get everyone else here killed? Hold your position!
markers.label: NPC 700303202

markers.name: Coward Soldier V2
say:
Look up at the sky...
Are those all Raptures...?

I... I can't do this!
I can't stay here! I'm going back!
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: FM Soldier V2
say:
Multiple Raptures spotted at 7 o'clock!
Engaging!
We've got Raptures aiming for the lead battleship's  main cannons! Concentrate your fire and take them out!
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: Fool Soldier V2
say:
We need to clear the airspace
to allow the pilots to take off!

Storm Bringer is coming,
but as long as we've got Wings of Victory, we can win!
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: Justice Soldier V2
say:
We have to protect the airship
until the Goddess squad arrives safely!

Leave this to me
and check if anyone else needs help.
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: Andersen V3
say:
Lilith is still undergoing repairs. 
Her body took a heavy toll in the last battle.
markers.label: NPC 7003028

markers.name: Dorothy V4
say:
How are you feeling,
Snow White?

You don't look too good.
I think it'd be best for you not to overdo it.
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V5
say:
Cinderella...!
The humiliation... I won't forget it any time soon.
Next time, she will quiver under the edge of my blade, mark my words.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Rapunzel V5
say: I told Red Hood she could trust me, but I failed her.

We will find a way to overcome this corruption,
so that no one will ever have to suffer from it again.
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: Andersen V4
say:
This engagement will mark the 213th time
that the Raptures have targeted the airship.

No matter how many times they attack,
we must continue defending it.
markers.label: NPC 7003028

markers.name: Dorothy V5
say:
We emerge from the fray unscathed yet again.
I can't even remember when I last took a walk.

It's times like this
when I really start to miss the little stuff. The daily routines.
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V6
say:
Do you still detest Red Hood?
I must admit, I can understand why you would feel that way.

We don't know when we might have to fight again,
so rest up.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Lilith V5
say: Actually, I believe it was the 222nd time, Commander.

Oh, Snow White.
It's been a long time, hasn't it?
Are you faring any better than before?
markers.label: NPC 7003029

markers.name: Rapunzel V6
say:
Repeated fighting has exhausted the mass-produced Nikkes.
I'm worried about how long they can hold out.

... True. It's been so long that
I've even started missing Red Hood's puerile pranks.
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: Dorothy V7
say:
As of this moment, I will be assuming
temporary command of the Goddess Squad.
Scarlet, this is not a good time.
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V8
say:
If you intend on giving me orders,
then you'll have to best me in a fight.

Very well. Now is indeed not an appropriate time.
My apologies. I misspoke.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Andersen V5
say:
Anachiro was sighted near the Ark's entrance.
Reports indicate that she's giving the UFH a hell of a time.

Anachiro is becoming bolder.
I wouldn't be surprised if it was willing to make a direct charge towards the Ark's entrance.
Everyone, prepare firmly and be ready for any contingency.
markers.label: NPC 7003028

markers.name: Dorothy V6
say:
Anachiro...
This name suits her. The destroyer of all orders.
I still can't believe that she ended up becoming a lapdog for the Raptures.
Would such a primitive weapon have any effect on her?
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V7
say:
I care naught of what has become of her.
My blade shall slide across her gullet all the same.

Then we'll definitely see
whether this so-called "primitive" weapon is effective.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Lilith V6
say:
I'm not going to die, Snow White.
It is not my time to go.
Even Red Hood would understand that.
markers.label: NPC 7003029

markers.name: Rapunzel V7
say:
As long as we can find a way to eliminate the nanomachines,
we should be able to overcome the corruption.
Lord, please grant me an unremitting will.
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: Angry Soldier V3
say:
What are you doing? Do you want have a death wish?
Stay low and take cover!

Take cover and pull yourself together!
I'll be back with some ammo.
markers.label: NPC 700303202

markers.name: Fool Soldier V3
say:
The Raptures just keep coming!
I don't know how much longer we can hold out.
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: Justice Soldier V3
say:
Everyone stay frosty.
I've got a bad feeling about this.

We've got combat aircraft crashing down from above.
Watch out for falling debris!
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: Dorothy V8
say:
*Sigh* Finally, we can catch our breath.
When do you think Lilith and the Commander will return?
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V9
say:
Your marksmanship was most impressive.
Thou are progressing remarkably with the passage of time.

All is quiet now,
but our foes are legion, so I shall sharpen my sword post-haste.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Rapunzel V8
say: It should be around here somewhere...

S-Snow White?!
I-I... Um, I'm looking for a medical textbook!
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: Dorothy V12
say:
Another day, another victory.
We'll win next time as well.
Do you think we can rest at the Ark?
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V13
say:
My body doth feel most heavy.
I must have overexerted myself.

'Tis too early to throw in the towel.
I can still swing this blade of mine.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Rapunzel V12
say:
I think I'm hearing voices... 
from those who have been killed.
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: Dorothy V9
say:
We'll be arriving at the combat zone any minute.
Everyone get ready for deployment.
markers.label: Character 233

markers.name: Hongryeon V10
say:
Relay the command,
and I shall assume vanguard.

Splendid.
'Tis most exciting to have reason to brandish my blade.
markers.label: NPC 7003034

markers.name: Rapunzel V9
say:
I've got you covered from the rear.
Let me know if you need any help.

We'll be down straight away.
Snow White, get ready!
markers.label: NPC 7003035

markers.name: T-Coward V1
say:
Has anyone seen my friend?
She was right beside me a moment ago...
She said she'd be right back.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: T-Coward V2
say:
You Rapture scum!
You murdered my friends!
I'll kill every last one of you!
markers.label: NPC 700303202

markers.name: T-Coward V3
say:
You Rapture scum!
You murdered my friends!
I'll kill every last one of you!
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: T-Coward V4
say:
I'm not hiding anymore!
I'll kill all of you!
markers.label: NPC 700303202

markers.name: T-Coward V5
say:
We agreed that we'll have a good drink once we get back!
But I'll never see her again because of you!
markers.label: NPC 700303202

markers.name: T-Justice V1
say:
The sacrifices our comrades made...
They must have had a good reason, right?

Do you think giving our lives
will save humanity?
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: T-Justice V2
say:
There aren't that many left standing,
so it'd be best to consolidate our formation.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: T-Justice V3
say:
Stop! If you head out now, you'll be torn to shreds.
Don't let our emotions get the better of us!
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: T-Justice V4
say: I'm letting my emotions get the best of me.
In this case, I won't last long.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: T-Justice V5
say:
There aren't that many left standing,
so it'd be best to consolidate our formation.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: T-Justice V6
say:
Stop! If you head out now, you'll be torn to shreds.
Don't let our emotions get the better of us!
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: T-Justice V7
say: Pull yourself together and maintain formation!
Calm down! You're going to get yourself killed!
markers.label: NPC 7003032

markers.name: T-Justice V8
say:
Thanks to you all, humanity has survived.
It has been an honor serving with you... *sob*
markers.label: Character 300
